supplementaryReferences.quote: The fruit is edible, very sweet in taste
supplementaryReferences.note: January–July is fruit appearance in SANBI's account, not an explicit ripe-picking interval.

supplementaryReferences.title: Fruit-development duration has context
supplementaryReferences.quote: 4-5 months from flower fertilization to fruit ripening
supplementaryReferences.doc: World Agroforestry, Agroforestree Database, Berchemia discolor
supplementaryReferences.note: This is flower-to-fruit development, not years from planting. Its South African January–July fruiting statement is not an observed household picking window.

care: Use frost-free conditions: SANBI describes frost sensitivity despite drought resistance, with natural low-altitude riverbank bushveld in northern KwaZulu-Natal, Mpumalanga and Limpopo.
purchase: Ask for Berchemia discolor, not red ivory (B. zeyheri). Record actual local ripe-picking months.
